coordinate_system.time_scale: UTC labels; Horizons states requested in ICRF with Horizons' internal TDB integration

provenance.method: Representative inclined orbit using NASA's achieved 238 km perigee, 250 km apogee and 40.3-degree inclination; estimated ascent and final 60-minute deorbit/entry arc are constrained to Edwards AFB. Orbital plane phase and sample states are modeled, not Shuttle telemetry.
provenance.approximation_notes: Representative inclined orbit using NASA's achieved 238 km perigee, 250 km apogee and 40.3-degree inclination; estimated ascent and final 60-minute deorbit/entry arc are constrained to Edwards AFB. Orbital plane phase and sample states are modeled, not Shuttle telemetry.
